IPI AQM
Connect Genesys Cloud
Working prototype

AUTOMATED QUALITY MANAGEMENT FOR GENESYS CLOUD

More conversations understood.
Less manual scoring.

Jev answers specific quality questions in predefined formats. AQM turns those answers into transparent scores that people can inspect and challenge.

Take the guided demo →
Explore the prototype

Five minutes · fictional data · no live requests

From signal to understanding
Fictional preview

Resolution guidance needs a closer look.

PREPARED AI ANSWER
Clear next step
HUMAN JUDGMENT
Timeline not agreed

One conversation. The same published form. A useful disagreement.

See how calibration works →
THE OPPORTUNITY
Manual review should inform quality.
Not be the only way to see it.

Increase visibility across selected conversations, investigate the evidence, and use human judgment where it matters. Controlled coverage is a policy decision, not a claim of unlimited capacity.

WHY THIS APPROACH
Focused decisions. Transparent scoring. Human control.
Ask focused questions

Predefined answer formats evaluate specific criteria, with related questions batched in one request.

Apply agreed scoring rules

Weights, critical criteria and exact form versions make the score explainable.

Learn from disagreement

Human reviews preserve the original AI result and support calibration.

Typed answers can still be wrong. Confidence is not measured correctness; calibrate against human judgments. Confidence reference · checked 2026-10-03.

EXPLORE THE ECONOMICS
A small model bill. An honest starting point.

Structured, batched questions and very low model input cost make broader evaluation economically attractive. This is an illustrative planning estimate — model input cost only.

Conversations per month
0–1,000,000,000
Selected percentage
0–100%
Advanced assumptions
ESTIMATED JEV MODEL INPUT COST · USD
$16.80/month

50,000 conversations/month selected · 50,000 form evaluations · 50,000 AI requests · 400M input tokens/month.

Current assumptions: 100,000 conversations/month · 50% selected · 1 form(s) per conversation · 1 AI request(s) per form · 8,000 input tokens per request.

Input includes transcript and quality questions. Repeated transcript input across conditional requests counts again. Average forms and requests may be fractional planning equivalents.

Official Jev 1.13 pricing: $0.042/M input tokens; output free. Checked 2026-10-03; rates may change.

Excluded: transcription, Genesys licensing/retrieval, hosting, storage and network costs, retries, taxes and human review. Validate capacity during the pilot.

They should return later. Try signing in again.

All right, I will try. Thanks.

Define quality
What does good mean?

Quality is defined explicitly. AI doesn’t invent the scoring model.

Resolution & ownership · Published version 3

Acknowledged the impact

Did the agent acknowledge the customer’s difficulty?

Yes / No

Issue resolved

Was the customer’s stated issue resolved?

Yes / No

Clear next step

Was a specific next step and realistic timeline agreed?

Clear next step / Timeline not agreed

Action and timeline must be agreed. Clear earns 100% credit; missing timeline earns 0%. This criterion has double weight within Resolution and is critical: a failure means the form fails.

Customer care contributes one third of the score; Resolution contributes two thirds. The pass threshold is 75%.

If the issue is unresolved, an additional question asks who owns the escalation. It does not apply to Jamie’s resolved access issue.

Reuse agreed standards

Reusable question groups and answer sets keep common standards consistent across forms. Each published form keeps its own versioned snapshot.

pages.text:
IPI AQM
Connect Genesys Cloud
Working prototype

AUTOMATED QUALITY MANAGEMENT FOR GENESYS CLOUD

More conversations understood.
Less manual scoring.

Jev answers specific quality questions in predefined formats. AQM turns those answers into transparent scores that people can inspect and challenge.

Take the guided demo →
Explore the prototype

Five minutes · fictional data · no live requests

From signal to understanding
Fictional preview

Resolution guidance needs a closer look.

PREPARED AI ANSWER
Clear next step
HUMAN JUDGMENT
Timeline not agreed

One conversation. The same published form. A useful disagreement.

See how calibration works →
THE OPPORTUNITY
Manual review should inform quality.
Not be the only way to see it.

Increase visibility across selected conversations, investigate the evidence, and use human judgment where it matters. Controlled coverage is a policy decision, not a claim of unlimited capacity.

WHY THIS APPROACH
Focused decisions. Transparent scoring. Human control.
Ask focused questions

Predefined answer formats evaluate specific criteria, with related questions batched in one request.

Apply agreed scoring rules

Weights, critical criteria and exact form versions make the score explainable.

Learn from disagreement

Human reviews preserve the original AI result and support calibration.

Typed answers can still be wrong. Confidence is not measured correctness; calibrate against human judgments. Confidence reference · checked 2026-10-03.

EXPLORE THE ECONOMICS
A small model bill. An honest starting point.

Structured, batched questions and very low model input cost make broader evaluation economically attractive. This is an illustrative planning estimate — model input cost only.

Conversations per month
0–1,000,000,000

0–100%
Advanced assumptions
ESTIMATED JEV MODEL INPUT COST · USD
$16.80/month

50,000 conversations/month selected · 50,000 form evaluations · 50,000 AI requests · 400M input tokens/month.

Current assumptions: 100,000 conversations/month · 50% selected · 1 form(s) per conversation · 1 AI request(s) per form · 8,000 input tokens per request.

Input includes transcript and quality questions. Repeated transcript input across conditional requests counts again. Average forms and requests may be fractional planning equivalents.

Official Jev 1.13 pricing: $0.042/M input tokens; output free. Checked 2026-10-03; rates may change.

Excluded: transcription, Genesys licensing/retrieval, hosting, storage and network costs, retries, taxes and human review. Validate capacity during the pilot.

IPI AQM

Chapter 2 of 5

Define quality
What does good mean?

Quality is defined explicitly. AI doesn’t invent the scoring model.

Resolution & ownership · Published version 3

Acknowledged the impact

Did the agent acknowledge the customer’s difficulty?

Yes / No

Issue resolved

Was the customer’s stated issue resolved?

Yes / No

Clear next step

Was a specific next step and realistic timeline agreed?

Clear next step / Timeline not agreed

Action and timeline must be agreed. Clear earns 100% credit; missing timeline earns 0%. This criterion has double weight within Resolution and is critical: a failure means the form fails.

Customer care contributes one third of the score; Resolution contributes two thirds. The pass threshold is 75%.

If the issue is unresolved, an additional question asks who owns the escalation. It does not apply to Jamie’s resolved access issue.

Reuse agreed standards

Reusable question groups and answer sets keep common standards consistent across forms. Each published form keeps its own versioned snapshot.

Chapter 1 of 5

The customer case
Was Jamie given a clear next step?

Jamie needs account access before the next shift. Alex restores access, but the team settings are still missing.

Jamie Taylor with Alex Morgan
Jamie

The reset link will not work. I need access before my next shift.

Alex

I understand how frustrating that is. Let us try a fresh reset link.

Jamie

That worked. How long until my team settings return?

Alex

They should return later. Try signing in again.

Jamie

All right, I will try. Thanks.

Access is restored. “Later” leaves Jamie without an agreed timeline.

Chapter 2 of 5

Define quality
What does good mean?

Quality is defined explicitly. AI doesn’t invent the scoring model.

Resolution & ownership · Published version 3

Acknowledged the impact

Did the agent acknowledge the customer’s difficulty?

Yes / No

Issue resolved

Was the customer’s stated issue resolved?

Yes / No

Clear next step

Was a specific next step and realistic timeline agreed?

Clear next step / Timeline not agreed

Action and timeline must be agreed. Clear earns 100% credit; missing timeline earns 0%. This criterion has double weight within Resolution and is critical: a failure means the form fails.

Customer care contributes one third of the score; Resolution contributes two thirds. The pass threshold is 75%.

If the issue is unresolved, an additional question asks who owns the escalation. It does not apply to Jamie’s resolved access issue.

Reuse agreed standards

Reusable question groups and answer sets keep common standards consistent across forms. Each published form keeps its own versioned snapshot.
